summary: AMC Global Media Inc. filed an 8-K on September 4, 2026, disclosing a settlement agreement with Robert Kirkman and other plaintiffs resolving 2022 breach-of-contract claims tied to The Walking Dead and Fear The Walking Dead. Total consideration is $120 million: $85 million cash due by September 18, 2026, plus $35 million by January 31, 2027, treated as an advance against future Modified Adjusted Gross Receipts participation. No board recommendation or advisor named. AMC takes an approximately $85 million charge in Q3 2026 and lowered 2026 free cash flow guidance to about $150 million from $220 million.
